pages.text: This is an extremely complex machine. It requires a Cage of Curses placed beneath it as a soul energy supply, and four Runestone Engraved Tables with cores embedded as its foundation before it can be used. The mechanics of the Rune Reactor are very intricate. It has two modes: Turret mode and Field mode.

Place the Runestone Engraved Tables at the four corners of a rectangle centered on the Rune Reactor. Place any core (Animation/Hunger/Mystery/Wind) in each Runestone Engraved Table — the cores do not affect spell effects, they only serve as structural components.
Then place a staff equipped with a spell focus onto the Rune Reactor. When there is a valid target within range, the Rune Reactor will automatically cast spells.

Additionally, the reactor can also hold totem-like items or binding gems, which switches it to Field mode. In this mode, the reactor can also form a strange field together with other Runestone Engraved Tables within its effective range.

The fields include: Anti-Magic Field, Growth Field, Repulsion Field, Attraction Field, Ascension Field, Fall Field, Hunger Field, String Burial Field, Weakening Field, and Teleportation Field. They change depending on the cores placed on the engraved tables.
